description: A shell script used for building Docker images for various services in a project. It defines services, manages proxies, and automates the Docker build process for multiple service modules.

methods.name: print_usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: print_used_proxies
methods.description: Outputs the current proxy settings being used.

methods.name: build_docker_image
methods.description: Builds a Docker image for a specified service module.

methods.name: build_all_docker_images
methods.description: Iterates through all defined services and builds Docker images for each.

methods.name: set_proxies
methods.description: Configures HTTP and HTTPS proxy environment variables.

methods.name: evaluate_script_arguments
methods.description: Parses and handles command-line arguments to the script.
